sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "systemperformance"."devlink" AS e, "devices"."brwtype" AS g, SUM("systemperformance"."warncount") AS m1, AVG("systemperformance"."errcount") AS m2, (SUM("systemperformance"."warncount") - AVG("systemperformance"."errcount")) AS m3 FROM "systemperformance" JOIN "devices" ON "devices"."devkey" = "systemperformance"."devlink"  GROUP BY "systemperformance"."devlink", "devices"."brwtype"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT SUM("s2"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s2"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s2"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s2"
construction: agg:devices within devices.brwtype > diff > agg:g > agg:all
why: total of warnings per devices within devices.brwtype (additive)
average of errors per devices within devices.brwtype
total of warnings minus average of errors: both in count of performance records, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to g: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
coarsen to all: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
